name: MIRA-CSI
expansion: Missingness-Informed Recognition of Activities from Wi-Fi CSI
status: Proposed research implementation; performance and novelty not established
split: Existing manifest unchanged. Per fold: source train 504, source validation 168, source familiar test 168, excluded environment 420. Participants disjoint within each fold.
augmentation: For cnn_augmented and mira_csi, each source-training sample is clean with probability 0.5; otherwise random/contiguous loss, fraction 0.1/0.3/0.5 and linear/nearest/source-mean imputer selected uniformly. Same draw order for the paired models at a given seed and fold.
mira_contribution: 18 amplitude bands plus binary observation mask and normalized distance to nearest observation; pooling weighted by downsampled observation coverage. Standard CNN components and mask-aware learning are prior art; this implementation and the specific combination are under evaluation, not claimed first or SOTA.

minirocket.implementation: Official basic multivariate reference with real Numba JIT; not prior NumPy compatibility smoke test

test_conditions: Clean plus random/contiguous 50% missingness, three imputers and five mask seeds (31 conditions per model). This extension focuses on 50%; original 10% and 30% baseline results remain separate.
imputation_rules: Observed values unchanged. Linear interpolation holds nearest observed boundary; nearest ties select earlier observation; source_mean uses channel mean computed solely from source training files. Offline interpolation can use later observed samples, so no causal streaming claim.
calibration: One scalar temperature per model/fold/training seed fit on clean source-validation logits, bounds 0.1 to 10; frozen on all test conditions.
primary_measure: Pooled held-environment macro F1 and accuracy per training seed, averaging five mask realizations before comparing methods. Report all folds and seeds; no target-label selection.
limitations: Room and participant-cohort effects are confounded.
Synthetic missing normalized packet positions are not measured network outages.
Masks are class independent; no missingness-as-label assumption.
Seven-class recognition does not estimate body pose, temperature, vital signs or the current user.
One dataset/subset cannot establish universal robustness or superiority.
